scripts.dev: concurrently --restart-tries 3 --restart-after 2000 --prefix-colors "blue,cyan,cyan" -n "hub,dosje,storybook" "bash -c 'cd apps/hub && exec ./node_modules/.bin/next dev --turbopack -p 3000'" "bash -c 'cd apps/dosje && exec ./node_modules/.bin/next dev --turbopack -p 3001'" "bash -c 'cd apps/storybook && exec env NODE_PATH=$(pwd)/node_modules ../../node_modules/.bin/storybook dev -p 6006 --ci'"
scripts.dev:storybook: bash -c 'cd apps/storybook && exec env NODE_PATH=$(pwd)/node_modules ../../node_modules/.bin/storybook dev -p 6006'
scripts.check: npm run check:hub && npm run check:dosje
scripts.lint: npm run lint:hub && npm run lint:dosje
